positions.name: Applied Materials, Inc.
positions.catalyst: FQ3 2026 (Aug 13 post-close) beat AND a large guidance raise: revenue $9.12B (+25% YoY) vs $8.99B est, adj. EPS $3.50 vs $3.40 est; FQ4 guide revenue $10.25B +/- $0.5B vs $9.54B consensus (~7% above) and adj. EPS $3.82-4.22 vs $3.69 est, with management citing 'unprecedented' AI-driven demand, multi-year visibility and another 'strong growth year' in 2027. Stock nonetheless gapped DOWN ~6% pre-market to ~$502 on elevated expectations after a ~184% 52-week run.
positions.driver: Asymmetric because the catalyst is available at a discount rather than a premium: a strongly positive fundamental surprise paired with a negative price reaction is a favorable mean-reversion / PEAD setup. Entry ~$502 vs $548 pre-print and a $639 consensus target (~27% above entry), with semis broadly on the cusp of a new bull leg and the S&P 500 at a record high. MarketWatch reports analysts calling the dip a buy. Definable stop just under the pre-market low.
positions.risks: A down-gap on a beat can extend — the tape is de-rating the multiple (46x trailing) after a huge run, and Reuters flags intensifying competition (China domestic toolmakers, share risk) as the overhang. Three-day hold across the weekend adds gap risk. Beta 1.62; ex-dividend Aug 20. No forced buyer here — a discretionary bounce bet, unlike a mechanical index-flow trade.
